citations.claim: body 0 centre east of wall before crossing
body 0 centre west of wall after crossing, proving wall was tunnelled between steps 61 and 62
extreme speed causing per-step displacement larger than wall width

explanation: Light body (m=0.2) vs heavy body (m=20) with e=1 generated extreme velocity ~311 by step 61 via elastic collisions/wall bounces. Per-step displacement ~10 units exceeds 2-wide wall [9,11]x[2,4]. Substepping (200 substeps) did not prevent centre crossing wall between recorded steps 61 (x~13.6 east of wall) and 62 (x~8.84 west of wall), triggering no_tunneling.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 61 and 62

vision_note: In steps 59 to 61 the small red circle drifts leftward to a position just east of the central grey square near the large blue circle. In step 62 it suddenly jumps to the bottom edge far southwest of the square, having crossed past through the wall region in a single frame.
